The '''Imperial Landing Zone''' was a staging ground for the forces of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[CZ-198]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref> when it was invaded by both the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Titans of Industry" /> during the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]'s reorganization of [[3636 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref>

Imperial personnel stationed in the area to provide supplies to combatants included [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeants]] [[Londar (Twi'lek)|Londar]] and [[Kidles (male)|Kidles]], as well as several [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of [[Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kresk]] had a presence in the area via his protocol droid [[C-E29]].<ref name="location" />

Following the [[seizure of CZ-198]], when the [[Dread War]] started, [[Darth Marr]]'s call to arms was delivered to [[CZ-198]] with an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] droid [[D5-F2]], tasked to find able Imperial agents still stationed at the Imperial landing zone.<ref name="location" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Landing Zone appears on the moon CZ-198, added as part of the Game Update 2.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="Titans of Industry" />
